grid.expression: SELECT USOPRODUTO, ROUND(AVG(DIAS), 2) AS LEADTIME FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, (SELECT OPC.OPCAO FROM TDDCAM CAM INNER JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON CAM.NUCAMPO = OPC.NUCAMPO WHERE CAM.NOMETAB = 'TGFPRO' AND CAM.NOMECAMPO = 'USOPROD' AND OPC.VALOR = PRO.USOPROD) AS USOPRODUTO, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DATAPEDIDO, TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) AS DATAPREVISTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) AS DATANOTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DIAS, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' THEN 15 ELSE 30 END AS PRAZOESPERADO, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 15 THEN 'N' WHEN PRO.USOPROD <> 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 30 THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS NOPRAZO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'O' AND ITC.DTENTSAI BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND PAR.CODPARC = NVL(:CODPARC, PAR.CODPARC) AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('M', 'C') GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)), TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) ) GROUP BY USOPRODUTO

SELECT CODPROD, DESCRPROD, ROUND(AVG(DIAS), 2) AS LEADTIME FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, (SELECT OPC.OPCAO FROM TDDCAM CAM INNER JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON CAM.NUCAMPO = OPC.NUCAMPO WHERE CAM.NOMETAB = 'TGFPRO' AND CAM.NOMECAMPO = 'USOPROD' AND OPC.VALOR = PRO.USOPROD) AS USOPRODUTO, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DATAPEDIDO, TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) AS DATAPREVISTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) AS DATANOTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DIAS, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' THEN 15 ELSE 30 END AS PRAZOESPERADO, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 15 THEN 'N' WHEN PRO.USOPROD <> 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 30 THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS NOPRAZO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'O' AND ITC.DTENTSAI BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND PAR.CODPARC = NVL(:CODPARC, PAR.CODPARC) AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('M', 'C') GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)), TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) ) GROUP BY CODPROD, DESCRPROD

grid.expression: SELECT CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_ENTREGAS, SUM(CASE WHEN NOPRAZO = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_NO_PRAZO, SUM(CASE WHEN NOPRAZO = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_FORA_PRAZO, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN NOPRAZO = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 2) AS PERCENTUAL_ONTIME, ROUND(AVG(DIAS), 2) AS LEADTIME_MEDIO, MIN(DIAS) AS MELHOR_PRAZO, MAX(DIAS) AS PIOR_PRAZO FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, (SELECT OPC.OPCAO FROM TDDCAM CAM INNER JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON CAM.NUCAMPO = OPC.NUCAMPO WHERE CAM.NOMETAB = 'TGFPRO' AND CAM.NOMECAMPO = 'USOPROD' AND OPC.VALOR = PRO.USOPROD) AS USOPRODUTO, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DATAPEDIDO, TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) AS DATAPREVISTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) AS DATANOTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DIAS, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' THEN 15 ELSE 30 END AS PRAZOESPERADO, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 15 THEN 'N' WHEN PRO.USOPROD <> 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 30 THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS NOPRAZO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'O' AND ITC.DTENTSAI BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND PAR.CODPARC = NVL(:CODPARC, PAR.CODPARC) AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('M', 'C') GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)), TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) ) GROUP BY CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL ORDER BY PERCENTUAL_ONTIME DESC, TOTAL_ENTREGAS DESC, RAZAOSOCIAL

SELECT NUNOTA, SEQUENCIA, CODTIPOPER, DESCROPER, CODPARC, RAZAOSOCIAL, CODPROD, DESCRPROD, USOPROD, USOPRODUTO, CODPARCFORN, DATAPEDIDO, DATAPREVISTA, DATANOTA, DIAS, PRAZOESPERADO, CASE WHEN NOPRAZO = 'S' THEN 'No Prazo' ELSE 'Fora do Prazo' END AS CLASSIFICACAO, NOPRAZO FROM ( SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, (SELECT OPC.OPCAO FROM TDDCAM CAM INNER JOIN TDDOPC OPC ON CAM.NUCAMPO = OPC.NUCAMPO WHERE CAM.NOMETAB = 'TGFPRO' AND CAM.NOMECAMPO = 'USOPROD' AND OPC.VALOR = PRO.USOPROD) AS USOPRODUTO, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DATAPEDIDO, TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) AS DATAPREVISTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) AS DATANOTA, MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) AS DIAS, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' THEN 15 ELSE 30 END AS PRAZOESPERADO, CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 15 THEN 'N' WHEN PRO.USOPROD <> 'C' AND MAX(TRUNC(ITC.DTENTSAI)) - TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)) > 30 THEN 'N' ELSE 'S' END AS NOPRAZO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN TGFVAR VAR ON VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFCAB ITC ON ITC.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFITE ITV ON ITV.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND ITV.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA WHERE CAB.TIPMOV = 'O' AND ITC.DTENTSAI BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND PAR.CODPARC = NVL(:CODPARC, PAR.CODPARC) AND PRO.USOPROD IN ('M', 'C') GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA, ITE.SEQUENCIA, TOP.CODTIPOPER, TOP.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, PRO.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, PRO.USOPROD, PRO.CODPARCFORN, TRUNC(NVL(ITE.DTINICIO, CAB.DTPREVENT)), TRUNC(CAB.DTPREVENT) ) WHERE CODPROD = :CODPROD ORDER BY DATANOTA, NUNOTA, SEQUENCIA
